# pve_node_disk_lvm (Resource)

LVM volume group created on a node's disk(s). The API offers no per-VG read; the list endpoint is filtered by VG name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_node_disk_lvm" "example" {
  device = "CHANGE_ME"
  name   = "CHANGE_ME"
  node   = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `device` (String) The block device you want to create the volume group on
- `name` (String) The storage identifier.
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Optional

- `add_storage` (Boolean) Configure storage using the Volume Group (default: 0)
- `cleanup_config` (Boolean) Marks associated storage(s) as not available on this node anymore or removes them from the configuration (if configured for this node only). (default: 0)
- `cleanup_disks` (Boolean) Also wipe disks so they can be repurposed afterwards. (default: 0)

### Read-Only

- `children` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--children))
- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: node/name (also the `terraform import` format).
- `leaf` (Boolean)

<a id="nestedatt--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `children`

Read-Only:

- `children` (Attributes List) The underlying physical volumes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--children--children))
- `free` (Number) The free bytes in the volume group
- `leaf` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) The name of the volume group
- `size` (Number) The size of the volume group in bytes

<a id="nestedatt--children--children"></a>
### Nested Schema for `children.children`

Read-Only:

- `free` (Number) The free bytes in the physical volume
- `leaf` (Boolean)
- `name` (String) The name of the physical volume
- `size` (Number) The size of the physical volume in bytes
